hero.title: It knows the actual order
hero.lede: Bring in your products, customers and orders. From then on an agent looks things up the way you would.

image.alt: A delivery courier on a bicycle carrying parcels.

threeFiles.title: Three files, as Shopify exports them
threeFiles.lede: All 25 products, 150 customers and 281 orders came in with nothing skipped.

items.title: Export from your store
items.text: Shopify, WooCommerce or any spreadsheet with the same columns.

items.title: Drop the files in
items.text: Settings, then Store data. It shows how many rows it added and skipped.

items.title: Do it again tomorrow
items.text: A newer export updates what's there and doesn't add duplicates.

startFresh.title: Start from nothing
lede: Crewline opens on a sample shop so you can press every button. Start over clears it, and a checklist appears and ticks itself off as you go.

items.question: Is it connected live to my store?
items.answer: No. Orders are as fresh as your last import, and there's no live link to Shopify.

items.question: Does the money actually move?
items.answer: Not yet. Crewline records the refund, the order changes and the customer is told. You still press the button in your store or payment provider until those connections exist.
